title: Validate Skill manifest against Module schemas
goal: Reject module-backed Skill manifests whose declared input or output schema identifiers differ from the resolved Module contract.
context: ModuleBackedSkillExecutor currently passes the manifest input schema into ModuleRuntime and verifies output JSON only as a string dictionary. It does not ensure the manifest's output schema identifier matches the registered Module's output contract, so an incompatible manifest can be reported verified.
forbidden_changes: Do not claim schema identifiers provide structural JSON Schema validation; this task validates contract identity only.
Do not add implicit capabilities or bypass ModuleRuntime policy.
Do not dynamically load arbitrary executor names from Skill.md metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Module-backed execution requires a registered Module contract matching both manifest input and output schema identifiers.
Skill verification returns false when the declared schema contract does not match the registered Module.
Regression tests cover schema mismatch while existing matching-schema Skill execution remains green.
verification: Check Swift package tests + repository integrity and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if existing matching-schema Skills regress; keep structural input/output schema validation tracked separately.
